component.name: Nebula Commander
component.summary: Manage your Nebula Commander VPN connection

description.p: Desktop client for Nebula Commander: enroll this device, view connection status, and choose which offered subnet routes or exit node to accept. Talks to the ncclient systemd service over a system D-Bus API rather than doing any networking itself, so the nebula-commander-service package (or equivalent) must be installed and running separately.

screenshot.caption: Device status, service control, and subnet route/exit node selection
